title: COLD STORAGE
style: Live-band jazz rap, warm and sophisticated, walking upright bass, brushed drums with rimshot snare and ride pulse, electric piano and vibraphone, real horn-section stabs, modal jazz harmony with ii-V movement, relaxed conversational rap vocal with sung phrase-end doubles, natural room ambience, live one-take human timing that breathes. Starts on solo upright bass. Keys enter, then brushes. Verses are conversational and low. Chorus lifts with horns and doubled vocal. A vibraphone break resets before the last verse. 80-100 BPM, D minor. one narrator, conversational and dry, sitting close to the mic, unhurried over a live band
exclude: 808s, distorted synths, hi-hat rolls, aggressive delivery, EDM build-ups
lyrics:
[Intro]
Winter came in quiet this year, no announcement, no door
Just a bill for the propane and a shorter list than before

[Verse 1]
I keep a chest freezer like a bank I never audit
Saving everything for a day that keeps on being postponed
Seed from the good tomatoes, paper money in a jar
A hard drive that I stopped plugging in, a passport with no stamps
There's a woman in the city who still asks about my mother
Got her number memorized and not a reason left to call her
The wood is stacked level and the roof is holding fine
It's the inventory of feelings that I cannot itemize

[Chorus] [Live Drums] [Upright Bass]
Cold storage and I forgot the code
(cold storage)
Everything is still in here and I don't know what it's for
(cold storage and I forgot the code)

[Verse 2]
Half of what I own is filed in boxes with no label
Promising the man I'll be that I will get to it when I'm able
There's a version of me sleeping in the county clerk's basement
He signed a name at twenty-two he cannot now erase, and
Downstate they trade the same three numbers all night long
Up here we call the waiting on them getting strong
My ledger is a shed door that will never really latch
Every winter I go through it and I put it all back

[Chorus] [Live Drums] [Upright Bass]
Cold storage and I forgot the code
(cold storage)
Everything is still in here and I don't know what it's for
(cold storage and I forgot the code)

[Bridge]
Nothing in the cellar ever spoils if you never eat it
Nothing in the chest ever heals if you never open it
So I'm standing in the door light with the key in my hand
Freezer humming like a sermon that I half understand

[Chorus] [Live Drums] [Upright Bass]
Cold storage and I forgot the code
(cold storage)
Everything is still in here and I don't know what it's for
(cold storage and I forgot the code)
